reason: The default tree correctly shows both import generations and every module. A long identifier wraps and separate branches are noisier, but the hierarchy remains readable without manual placement.
dsl_nastiness: Moderate: seven pins and seven sizes recover a very simple asymmetric tree after the unarrowed-edge refinement removed automatic depth. The final source remains easy to read, but its geometry is less resilient than v0.
residuals: Shared trunk and sparse branch labels remain separate repeated edges.
v1 undirected hierarchy collapse is preserved.
Slightly bolder/smaller type and different spacing.
Arrowless native relations use directed=false, so native logical direction is weaker than the directed import concept; the final hierarchy supplies visual direction.
label_edit_resilience: Predicted: v0 adapts labels more naturally; v2 fixes widths/heights and coordinates, so module renames can require intervention.
visual_review: Original, v0, v1, v2 and full comparison sheet inspected by corpus author. Native sources frozen after final allowed cycle.
